name: sentence-mine
title_zh: 从YouTube和Naver现挖地道韩语句子
tagline_zh: 别再用课本上的生硬韩语了。从你爱看的视频和新闻里自动挖出短句，带来源链接，当天就能做成复习卡片，学的是活人说的话。
tagline_en: Stop drilling textbook Korean. Pull short, natural sentences from videos & news you actually watch, with source.
desc_en: Mine short, natural Korean sentences from YouTube or Naver media for fresh lessons and daily digests.
why_zh: 它不靠语料库，而是跟着你的兴趣走——你订阅什么频道，它就挖什么语境。句子短、真实、带出处。
why_en: It follows your interests, not a fixed corpus—mining short, real sentences with source links so you can revisit the original.
limit_zh: 只挖YouTube和Naver媒体上的韩语字幕/文本；需要网络稳定。不处理长句、不翻译。
limit_en: Only mines Korean subtitles/text from YouTube & Naver media; needs stable internet. No translation, no grammar notes, no long sentences—just.
title_en: Mine fresh Korean sentences from YouTube & Naver for daily.
